question: How does DINOv3 learn representations without labels?
direct_answer: It uses self-distillation: a student matches a teacher’s outputs on different augmented views of the same image.
expanded_answer: The model creates a training signal by comparing views of the same image rather than using human labels. The student is trained to reproduce the teacher’s predictions across crops and other augmentations, which encourages invariance to view changes while preserving shared semantic content.
key_points: Student and teacher see different augmentations
common_wrong_ideas: Believing self-supervised learning means no training objective
Thinking the teacher is trained directly from labels
